kills.property: Calling withdrawAll must never change the stored owner, regardless of the recipient.
kills.change_summary: Insert an assignment that overwrites the owner state variable with _recipient, observable via the public owner getter.

kills.property: A successful owner withdrawAll must always leave the contract with zero balance, i.e. all funds are actually sent out.
kills.change_summary: Remove the transfer so no funds are ever sent out of the contract.

kills.property: If withdrawAll succeeds, it must drain the contract's entire balance to zero; the mutant leaves 1 wei behind.
kills.change_summary: Transfer only 1 wei instead of the entire contract balance, leaving the rest of the funds in the contract.

kills.property: When the caller is the contract owner, withdrawAll must succeed (not revert); the mutant reverts for the legitimate owne
kills.change_summary: Replace the owner authorization check with a check against address(this), so the original owner can no longer withdraw.
